metadata.title: AdvancedVPNDeployment
metadata.description:
Big Thanks to Paul Stancer and Jeff Winn for their skills and efforts in making this module possible.
Paul Stancer's 'VPNCredentialsHelper' module is a dependency for this module to work. This module will automatically install Paul's module upon using the creation function of this module if it is not installed prior.



Creates advanced VPN Connection. This is built with Meraki VPN connections in mind but should be able to create any VPN connection other than EAP current as that requires additional input for certificates.

This tool has only been currently tested for Meraki L2TP connections.




Please send any feedback, reviews, comments, concerns and/or questions to powershellcoder@outlook.com

Im interested in knowing any feedback and also suggestions.




Use:

[ Create-AdvancedVPNConnection -Syntax ]
[ Connect-VPNConnection -Syntax ]


for syntax, examples and notes on the use of this module.




Included Functions:


Create-AdvancedVPNConnection

Connect-VPNConnection

Disconnect-VPNConnection

findings.description: A credential-like variable appears to be assigned a literal value. Review the source; the matched value is redacted.
